crossRefs.note: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

translations.web: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”
translations.bsb: Then Esau said, “Let us be on our way, and I will go ahead of you.”
translations.kjv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go
translations.asv: And he said, Let us take our journey, and let us go, and I will go before thee.
